narrative:
## Handover Summary — Cost of Care

Workforce, supplies, facility and transport drivers validated against the care-day plan. Cost of care ratio held at 77.5%.

## Key Decisions
• 180 agency nursing and therapy roles converted to permanent contracts
• Digital therapy covers 8% of orthopaedic group sessions, reducing therapist overtime
• Energy savings from the modernisation programme phased from Q2

## Recommendation for Workforce Planning
Tie nursing FTE to occupied beds per clinic so staffing follows the occupancy plan rather than last year's rota.
